## Out of scope reminder

This skill stays project-agnostic. Suggestions that wouldn't fit:

- Project-specific conventions (those go in your project's `CLAUDE.md`)
- Coupling to a specific tracker, language, or CI
- Breaking changes to `SPEC-NNN` / `HF-NNN` / `BUG-NNN` numbering

If your idea touches one of these, mention how to keep the skill itself generic.
